s1.syndrome_frame: Exertional dyspnea and syncope with underlying cardiovascular and neurological conditions
key_facts: Dyspnea on exertion for the past year
Syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness for a few minutes
Elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg
Normal breath and heart sounds without any murmurs
Pulmonary hypertension (mean pulmonary arterial pressure 32 mm Hg)
Right bundle-branch block (RBBB) and left anterior fascicular block (LAFB)

raw.syndrome_frame: Exertional dyspnea and syncope with underlying cardiovascular and neurological conditions
key_facts: Dyspnea on exertion for the past year
Syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness for a few minutes

Duchenne muscular dystrophy with cardiac involvement
Cardiac involvement in multiple system atrophy
Autonomic dysfunction in multiple system atrophy

shortlist.label: Pulmonary hypertension
shortlist.why_kept: Mean pulmonary arterial pressure of 32 mm Hg

shortlist.label: Cardiac amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Left atrial enlargement and uncertain diastolic function

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: First-degree atrioventricular block and third-degree AV block

shortlist.label: Sick sinus syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Sinus rhythm with first-degree atrioventricular block and PR prolongation

shortlist.label: Parkinson disease-related autonomic dysfunction
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has Parkinson disease and symptoms of autonomic dysfunction

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG findings, including first-degree atrioventricular block, third-degree AV block, and Mobitz type I second-degree AV block, along with symptoms of syncope and dyspnea on exertion, are consistent with sick sinus syndrome, which is characterized by dysfunction of the sinoatrial node.

rejected.label: Pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: While the patient has pulmonary hypertension, it does not fully explain the cardiac conduction abnormalities and syncope.

rejected.label: Cardiac amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence of amyloidosis, such as characteristic echocardiographic findings or laboratory tests, to support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The patient's ECG does not show evidence of supraventricular tachycardia, which is typical of AVNRT.

rejected.label: Parkinson disease-related autonomic dysfunction
rejected.why: While the patient has Parkinson's disease, the primary symptoms and ECG findings suggest a cardiac rather than a neurogenic cause of syncope and dyspnea.
